scene: Luxo Double Checker, Mark Fairchild's HDR Photographic Survey
terms: research and non-commercial publication; images downloaded, never redistributed
depends_on: output/sensing_numbers.json (unit 1.2): gain, dark sigma, clip levels, metered points

rows.name: raw mosaic
rows.note: one number per photosite, still mosaiced; the only measurement of the three

rows.name: developed 16-bit
rows.note: RGB order; two of every three numbers are interpolated

rows.name: developed 8-bit
rows.note: what imread would hand you; the tone curve is already baked in

exr.note: a merge on its own grid, not a rendering of this exposure; reference for nothing in this unit

patch_footprint.note: the box is the middle 40% of the patch; the patch itself is wider

decimation_error.reference: cv2.INTER_AREA — a box average over the footprint

error_vs_prediction.prediction: step / sqrt(12), the RMS error of a uniform quantizer

separability.plane: G1 photosites inside each patch box

demosaic_error.reference: 2x2 binning of the mosaic — every value a measured photosite
demosaic_error.method: OpenCV bilinear demosaic, binned the same way, differenced on the half-res grid

accuracy.reference: Konica Minolta CS-100 readings published with the survey: luminance and CIE 1931 x, y

naive_srgb.what_it_knows: nothing about the camera; assumes the developed file is sRGB

published_matrix.what_it_knows: Fairchild's D2x RGB->XYZ characterisation, applied to the linear mosaic

fitted_held_out.what_it_knows: a 3x3 fitted here, on patches it is then not scored on

worked_patch.note: OpenCV stores 8-bit hue halved, in [0,179]; degrees are twice the stored value

content_crop.why: the lamp, the chart and the lit table; the rest of the frame is near-black

rows.note: not comparable value by value: the two libraries returned different types

l2_wagon_wheel.note: apparent rotation is only ever known modulo the angle between spokes; a negative median means the wheel appears to turn against its true direction
apparent rotation is only ever known modulo the angle between spokes; a negative median means the wheel appears to turn against its true direction

rows.note: bands counted on the width-averaged, smoothed profile, so grain is not counted as banding

l5_chart_neutrality.reference: the chart's bottom row is neutral by manufacture: a* = b* = 0
l5_chart_neutrality.note: chroma here is the distance from neutral in the a*b* plane, which is the Delta-E this photograph can be held to without an external reference table

l3_response_curve.note: the file is not proportional to light; reading it as if it were understates the range between the lightest and darkest patch

l1_edge_profile.estimator: equivalent width: (rise) / (steepest slope), about 2.5 sigma for a blurred step
